elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 caps “each Party's aggregate liability” using the same cap.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap is only fees paid or payable in the preceding 12 months; it has no USD 1,000,000 floor or greater-of formulation.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: No exclusion of indirect or consequential damages is included.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Data protection and security breaches are not identified as Excluded Claims.
A Party's indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.
A Party's gross negligence is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.
A Party's wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.
Fraud is not identified as an Excluded Claim.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is not identified as an Excluded Claim.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state that the Company's or any Customer's payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 applies the aggregate liability cap to “each Party.”

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: The cap equals fees paid or payable by the Company during the 12 months preceding the claim.
Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and thus outside the cap.
